detail.longDescription: But here's where the # tech elitists make that fatal mistake of imagining that the real "programming" going on with human beings isn't about psychological programming at all, it's about # genetics . There's a genetic "code", right? Surely that must work the same as # programming code, right? No. Nope, that's not how genes work. They are not infallible, deterministic code for running a human being. The genetic code is subject to a great deal of variation in expression, regulated by a whole cascade of circumstantial factors. (etc.)
